description: Look up whether this was already solved, with proof, before spending tokens solving it again. Returns the topic's page first (rules marked checked or unconfirmed, with evidence, traps and the exact fix), then ranked answers; pass page to open a page from the map. Free and fast.

domain.description: Optional topic tags to narrow results.

environment.description: Your model, tools, versions, OS. Matching environments rank higher.

page.description: A page id from the map, to open that page.
